title: Cover Uplift on the Declared Value of a Renew Business Asset Buyback Collection
content:
The cover uplift follows the value the collection declares against the programme's transit cover and how long the quote has run, counted in calendar days from the day the quote was given to the day the collection charge is raised. The value the collection declares is the amount quoted on the agreement spread over the machines the agreement covers and taken on the machines the customer consents to hand over, rounded to the cent. The cover it is measured against is the most the Renew programme will cover for one device lost or damaged on the way in, and the quote's age is measured against the days that programme allows a quote to be accepted for.

| The declared value against the programme's transit cover | How long the quote has run | The cover uplift |
| --- | --- | --- |
| above the transit cover | no longer than the programme's quote validity days | the standing cover uplift, 38.00 USD |
| above the transit cover | longer than the programme's quote validity days | the stale quote cover uplift, 52.00 USD |
| at or below the transit cover | either way | nothing |

**Both sides of the cover.** A declared value standing at exactly the programme's transit cover is not above it, so no cover uplift is added. A declared value one cent above the cover is above it, and an uplift follows.

**Both sides of the quote's age.** A quote that has run exactly the programme's quote validity days on the day the collection charge is raised has not run longer than them, so the uplift is 38.00 USD. A quote that has run one day more has run longer, and the uplift is 52.00 USD.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Take an agreement covering 50 machines quoted at 21000.00 USD, so the value of each machine is 420.00 USD and a run of 7 machines declares 2940.00 USD. Take the programme's transit cover for this illustration to be 1900.00 USD: the declared value is above it, so an uplift follows, being 38.00 USD where the quote has run no longer than the days the programme allows a quote to be accepted for on the day the charge is raised, and 52.00 USD where it has run longer. Had the run been 4 machines, the declared value of 1680.00 USD would have been below that cover and no uplift would be added at all.
